cohort: 79,052 women from the Swedish Medical Birth Register who delivered by caesarean section only from 2005 through 2016, compared to a control group of women delivering vaginally only from the same register and time period.
finding: Caesarean section is associated with an increased risk of bowel obstruction, incisional hernia, and abdominal pain.
mod_finding: This study found that cesarean delivery was associated with increased risk for bowel obstruction, surgery for bowel obstruction, incisional hernia, surgery for incisional hernia, and abdominal pain.
